title: Three Years and One Short Wheel
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：invention　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 invention 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2001 the inventor ① made the invention that no assistant in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② invention, meaning the device itself and not the wheel, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; an invention, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ invention in that workshop had the same short wheel beside it, and the ④ invention at the far bench, meaning the model they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An invention, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the inventor said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the invention was the whole of the matter, meaning the idea and not the device. The ⑥ invention, meaning the idea and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; invention, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a device and an idea. He said the idea is the part they remember.

By 2006 the ⑦ invention had become a line in a patent, and the patent had become an argument about the short wheel. The ⑧ invention of the whole thing, the inventor wrote in June, was one workshop and three years of recording; invention, he said, is either the model at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ invention I remember is the device recorded in the patent, which closed in 2008 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. An ⑩ invention, my mother said in 2010, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; every invention, she said, is an idea that has agreed to look like a device. She said the idea was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 发明；发明物（指作坊里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 发明；发明物（指那项装置本身，与轮子相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the invention 制作这项发明
D. n. 发明；发明物（指留给孩子们照做的一个那一项）
E. n. 创制之事（抽象总称，指一处作坊的发明之事）
F. n. 发明；发明物（指专利里写到、被记下的的那一项）
G. n. 创意、构想（指一件事里人人都造却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 构想（抽象总称，指人人都造却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the invention that no assistant in the workshop would have recorded
The invention, meaning the device itself and not the wheel
the invention at the far bench
the invention was the whole of the matter
the invention had become a line in a patent
The invention of the whole thing
An invention, my mother said in 2010

answers.why: make the invention 意为“制作这项发明”，2001 年那位发明家把作坊里没有一位助手肯记录的一项发明做了一遍。
invention 意为“发明；发明物”，指那项装置本身而不是轮子，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被记录。
invention 意为“发明；发明物”，指作坊里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一只小小的轮子。
invention 意为“发明；发明物”，指最远那张工作台留给孩子们照做的一个那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
invention 意为“创意、构想”，指一件事里人人都造却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个创意就是那件事的全部。
invention 意为“构想”，指人人都造却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项装置，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
invention 意为“发明；发明物”，指专利里写到、被记下的的那一项，到 2006 年这一项成了专利里的一行。
invention 意为“创制之事”，发明家六月写道，整件事的发明之事是一处作坊和三个年的记录。
invention 意为“发明；发明物”，我记得的是专利里记录过的那一项，2008 年问世了，至今仍被说成作坊里最安静的一项。
invention 为抽象总称，母亲 2010 年说，发明是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的装置。
